_comment: Ratchet for bun run test:audit. Counts normally only go down: lower a number in the same commit that lowers the count. A number may go UP only when the DETECTOR got stricter and started seeing sites that were always there, never to admit new ones — raise it in the same commit as the detector change and record the reason below.
_wallClock: 0. The last ten sites went in one pass (see the PR that lowered this line). Each became either a BRACKET — two clock readings taken either side of the call, so the stamp is pinned to an instant inside them and no tolerance encodes machine speed — an EVENT ORDER (the estimator is released only after the route has answered; a shutdown marker due before the drain's own timer, which the event loop therefore always fires first), a WAIT rather than an assertion (the review-item precondition loops until the clock leaves the stamped millisecond, which slowness only makes arrive sooner), or a COUNT in the style of list-docs-linear.test.ts (paragraph re-scans, round trips, eager binds). Nothing was deleted to reach zero: every rewrite was shown red against a deliberately broken timing. A number here may go UP only if the detector gets stricter.
_sourceShape: 52. Raised from 18 when the source-shape detector stopped missing things, not when tests got worse: it had read only the test file itself, matched a path literal only where it ended at /src/ or /dist/, and required toContain/toMatch. That hid nine MCP tests reading packages/mcp/src through test/harness/mcp-source.ts, every read written as join(__dirname, '..', 'src', ...) or '../src/board/board-app.ts', and two stylesheet tests asserting a parsed value with toBe. What remains: the MCP suite's reads of the built plugin bundle and of its own sources; the server suite's reads of a published client release; seventeen app tests that read board-app.ts, app.ts, board-live-wiring.ts, doc-meeting-mount.ts and meeting-strip.ts as TEXT and assert on that text -- board-app.ts and app.ts have exported bootBoard and bootApp since PR 634, so the honest reason these stay is that nobody has converted them yet, not that there is nothing to import; and four stylesheet reads across three files, of which decide-option-hover-css.test.ts (a :hover treatment), board-nav-widget-clearance-css.test.ts (a calc() of max() and env() that happy-dom discards whole) and shell-grid-placement.test.ts (grid auto-placement, which needs a layout engine) are all beyond happy-dom.
